recommendation_text: Prior value location changes next-session transition probabilities, but the simple acceptance/rejection geometries do not monetize it after costs. Do not force a trade. Do not add Phase 42 filter soup.

spec.forbidden: No ORB, sweeps, DOM, MBP, MBO, delta, VWAP, TSMOM, discretionary P/b/D shapes, HVN/LVN as primary, 68/75 value-area search, cash/ETF substitutes, holdout tuning.

profile_source.reason: Databento trades schema is ~$0.30 per NQ RTH day; 2020-2026 ES+NQ is economically infeasible (~$1000). No local trade tape exists. Phase 41 uses 1m OHLCV volume distributed uniformly across each bar's tick range. Not a trade-by-trade profile. Do not promote a result that would reverse under true prints without a later tape phase.
profile_source.bar_volume_allocation: For each RTH 1m bar, volume V is split equally across ticks from low to high inclusive. Zero-volume bars skipped. High==low: all V at that tick.
profile_source.poc_tiebreak: Max volume tick. Ties: closest to session VWAP of typical price (H+L+C)/3; remaining ties take the lower tick.
profile_source.value_area: 70 percent. Single-row expansion from POC: at each step add the adjacent unused row with more volume. Equal volume: expand the lower-price side first. VAH=max included tick, VAL=min included tick.
profile_source.leak: Profile for day T uses only completed RTH 09:30-16:00 bars of the prior valid session. Next day cannot see T volume.

acceptance.A_1m_close: PRIMARY. First completed 1m close with VAL <= close <= VAH.
acceptance.B_two_1m: Two consecutive completed 1m closes inside value.
acceptance.C_5m: Diagnostic. First RTH-aligned 5m close inside value.

rejection.primary: 1m close rejection. Open outside. Price trades to/through the boundary (low<=VAH from above, high>=VAL from below). Then a completed 1m close back outside. Enter next 1m open.
rejection.first_trade: Diagnostic. Same test, but rejection is the first bar that trades the boundary then closes outside without a prior inside close.

primary_candidate.rules: Open outside prior value. Acceptance A: first 1m close inside [VAL,VAH]. Enter next 1m open +/- 1 tick toward POC (short if open was above VAH, long if below VAL). Stop = extreme of the outside excursion from RTH open through the signal bar, plus 1 tick. Target = prior POC. Flatten 15:55. Reject if stop > instrument max_stop_points. Same-bar stop+target = AMBIGUOUS.
primary_candidate.reason: Tests whether acceptance into prior value rotates toward POC. Locked before Phase 41 P&L. Competing rejection and inside-rotation candidates are reported, not substituted after seeing results.

secondary_candidates.rules: Open outside. Boundary test then 1m close back outside. Enter next open away from value. Stop = test extreme + 1 tick. Target = 1R. Flatten 15:55.
Open inside value and not exactly on POC. Enter 09:30 open +/- 1 tick toward POC. Stop = near value boundary +/- 1 tick. Target = POC. Flatten 15:55.

chrono.note: Predeclared. Same split as Phase 38/39. Train 2020-2024; holdout 2025-2026 YTD.

news.bls_0830: T-5m to T+5m around 08:30 never overlaps RTH 09:30 entries.
news.1000_et: No complete 10:00 calendar in-repo. Do not invent a daily 09:55-10:05 filter. Report as limitation. Optional diagnostic overlay only.

spec.hvn_lvn: Not primary. Skip unless VAH/VAL/POC already show a tradable edge.
spec.note: Phase 41 does not freeze. Candidate JSON only if VOLUME_PROFILE_EDGE_FOUND.

dvp.note: Read-only vs Phase 29 NQ DVP. No combination.
